# MALDI-MSI data preparation 

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(scater)
library(BiocParallel)
```


## 1. Read in data 

General patient metadata 

```{r}
metadata_all <- read_csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC_onlyPT.csv")

# Add TMA ID
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(metadata_all$grid,"x",metadata_all$x,"y",metadata_all$y),"NA","")
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(metadata_all$TMA_id, "x","X")
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(metadata_all$TMA_id, "y","Y")
metadata_all[is.na(metadata_all$x),]$TMA_id <- "CX7Y8" #was missing in data

metadata_all$subtype_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), metadata_all$subtype, "other")
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"

## Update survival censoring
metadata_all$status_OS <- ifelse(metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

metadata_all$OS_months <- metadata_all$survival_months

## Combine relevant disease progression categories
metadata_all$pT_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(metadata_all$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", metadata_all$pT_simple))

metadata_all$ISUP_simple <- metadata_all$ISUP
metadata_all$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(metadata_all$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", metadata_all$ISUP))
metadata_all$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", metadata_all$lymphocytes)

# Make sure stage, grade and necrose are encoded as characters
metadata_all$pT_simple <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_all$pT_simple))
metadata_all$pT_combined <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_all$pT_combined))

metadata_all$ISUP_simple <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_all$ISUP_simple))
metadata_all$ISUP_combined <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_all$ISUP_combined))

metadata_all$necrose <- as.character(paste0("NE",metadata_all$necrose))

# Revert NAs
metadata_all$necrose[metadata_all$necrose == "NENA"] <- NA

metadata_all$ISUP_simple[metadata_all$ISUP_simple == "GNA"] <- NA
metadata_all$ISUP_combined[metadata_all$ISUP_combined == "GNA"] <- NA

metadata_all$pT_simple[metadata_all$pT_simple == "TNA"] <- NA
metadata_all$pT_combined[metadata_all$pT_combined == "TNA"] <- NA

metadata_selected <- metadata_all %>% select(PID, TMA_id, subtype_combined, gender, age, age_bin, type, status_OS, OS_months, pT_simple, pT_combined, ISUP_simple, ISUP_combined, necrose) %>% as.data.frame

metadata_ccRCC <- metadata_selected %>% filter(subtype_combined == "ccRCC")
```


### MALDI-MSI data

### Match identifiers 

```{r}
# Raw data 
raw_data <- read_excel("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/datasharing/Lasse/Marlene/metabolome/data_analysis/MALDI_RCC_Data_LM.xlsx")

raw_out <- raw_data %>% pivot_longer(2:676, names_to = "ID", values_to = "intensity")

# Add Identifiers
raw_out$TMA <- ifelse(str_detect(raw_out$ID, "Z1"), "20", "224")
raw_out$spot_ID <- str_split(raw_out$ID, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
raw_out$tissue_type <- str_split(raw_out$ID, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,3]
```

```{r}
TMA20_anno <- read_excel("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/datasharing/Lasse/Marlene/metabolome/data_analysis/ZTMA20punchfile_LM.xls")
TMA20_anno$PID <- str_replace(TMA20_anno$`SP Number`, " ", "")

names(TMA20_anno)[names(TMA20_anno) == "DX name"] <- "subtype"
names(TMA20_anno)[names(TMA20_anno) == "Block ID"] <- "Block_ID"

names(TMA20_anno)[names(TMA20_anno) == "y localisation"] <- "y_localisation"

TMA224_anno <- read_excel("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/datasharing/Lasse/Marlene/metabolome/data_analysis/ZTMA224punchfile_LM.xlsx")
TMA224_anno$PID <- str_replace(TMA224_anno$`SP Number`, "B", "B20")
names(TMA224_anno)[names(TMA224_anno) == "# spots"] <- "spot_ID"
names(TMA224_anno)[names(TMA224_anno) == "DX name"] <- "subtype"
names(TMA224_anno)[names(TMA224_anno) == "Block ID"] <- "Block_ID"
names(TMA224_anno)[names(TMA224_anno) == "x localisation"] <- "x_localisation"
```

combine TMA anno

### Match raw data

```{r}
TMA20_anno$subtype_combined <- TMA_anno$subtype_combined[match(TMA20_anno$PID, TMA_anno$PID)]
TMA224_anno$subtype_combined <- TMA_anno$subtype_combined[match(TMA224_anno$PID, TMA_anno$PID)]

# Matching function
match_col <- function(x) {
  raw_out[[x]] <- ifelse(raw_out$TMA == 20,
                          TMA20_anno[[x]][match(raw_out$spot_ID, TMA20_anno$spot_ID)],
                          TMA224_anno[[x]][match(raw_out$spot_ID, TMA224_anno$spot_ID)])
  return(raw_out)
}

# columns to add
to_add <- c("PID", "subtype","subtype_combined", "Block_ID", "Grid")

# function call
for (col in to_add){
  raw_out <- match_col(col)
}

TMA_anno$ID <- raw_out$ID[match(TMA_anno$PID, raw_out$PID)]
```

## 2. Match annotations 

```{r}
peak_anno <- read_excel("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/datasharing/Lasse/Marlene/metabolome/data_analysis/RCC_Annotated_Mass_LM.xlsx")

#peak_anno$kegg_id[peak_anno$kegg_id == "NA"] <- NA
peak_anno$KEGG.pathway[peak_anno$KEGG.pathway == "NA"] <- NA
peak_anno$KEGG.map[peak_anno$KEGG.map == "NA"] <- NA

anno_mass <- peak_anno$Mass %>% unique # 444 Masses annotated
raw_mass <- raw_data$`m/z` %>% unique # 1258 m/z observed

setdiff(raw_mass, anno_mass) %>% length() # 909 m/z unannotated
setdiff(anno_mass, raw_mass) %>% length() # 95 m/z annotated but not observed
# 1258-909 = 349 m/z available for analysis
```


```{r}
df_1 <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/KEGG_anno_4ppm/KEGG_anno_MH.csv")
df_2 <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/KEGG_anno_4ppm/KEGG_anno_MH2O.csv")
df_3 <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/KEGG_anno_4ppm/KEGG_anno_MH2OH.csv")
df_4 <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/KEGG_anno_4ppm/KEGG_anno_MCl.csv")
df_5 <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/KEGG_anno_4ppm/KEGG_anno_MK2H.csv")
df_6 <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/KEGG_anno_4ppm/KEGG_anno_MNa2H.csv")

# subset to new metabolites
kegg_existing <- peak_anno$kegg_id %>% unique
df_1 <- df_1 %>% filter(!kegg_id %in% kegg_existing)
df_2 <- df_2 %>% filter(!kegg_id %in% kegg_existing)
df_3 <- df_3 %>% filter(!kegg_id %in% kegg_existing)
df_4 <- df_4 %>% filter(!kegg_id %in% kegg_existing)
df_5 <- df_5 %>% filter(!kegg_id %in% kegg_existing)
df_6 <- df_6 %>% filter(!kegg_id %in% kegg_existing)

# identifier
peak_anno$given <-rep("TRUE", nrow(peak_anno))
df_1$given <- rep("FALSE", nrow(df_1))
df_2$given <- rep("FALSE", nrow(df_2))
df_3$given <- rep("FALSE", nrow(df_3))
df_4$given <- rep("FALSE", nrow(df_4))
df_5$given <- rep("FALSE", nrow(df_5))
df_6$given <- rep("FALSE", nrow(df_6))

# add adduct
df_1$adduct <- rep("M-H", nrow(df_1))
df_2$adduct <- rep("M-H20", nrow(df_2))
df_3$adduct <- rep("M-H20-H", nrow(df_3))
df_4$adduct <- rep("M+K-2H", nrow(df_4))
df_5$adduct <- rep("M+Na-2H", nrow(df_5))
df_6$adduct <- rep("M+Cl", nrow(df_6))

# match colnames
colnames(df_1) <- colnames(df_2) <- colnames(df_3) <- colnames(df_4) <- colnames(df_5) <- colnames(df_6) <- c("Mass", "mass_adduct", "query", "kegg_id", "name", "result_mass", "KEGG.map", "KEGG.pathway","hmdb_id", "given","adduct")

# add to peak_anno
peak_anno_updated <- bind_rows(peak_anno %>% dplyr::select(Mass, kegg_id, accession, name, chemical_formula, adduct, adduct.mz, ppm, KEGG.pathway, KEGG.map, given), 
                               df_1 %>% dplyr::select(Mass, kegg_id, name, KEGG.map, KEGG.pathway, given, adduct),
                               df_2 %>% dplyr::select(Mass, kegg_id, name, KEGG.map, KEGG.pathway, given, adduct),
                               df_3 %>% dplyr::select(Mass, kegg_id, name, KEGG.map, KEGG.pathway, given, adduct),
                               df_4 %>% dplyr::select(Mass, kegg_id, name, KEGG.map, KEGG.pathway, given, adduct),
                               df_5 %>% dplyr::select(Mass, kegg_id, name, KEGG.map, KEGG.pathway, given, adduct),
                               df_6 %>% dplyr::select(Mass, kegg_id, name, KEGG.map, KEGG.pathway, given, adduct)) %>% arrange(Mass)

peak_anno_updated
```

### Subset peak annotation to hsa annotated compounds

```{r}
hsa_to_compound_df <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/cpd_in_hsa_pathways")

hsa_cpd <- hsa_to_compound_df$CompoundID %>% unique

peak_anno_updated <- peak_anno_updated %>% filter(kegg_id %in% hsa_cpd)

merged_df <- merge(peak_anno_updated, hsa_to_compound_df, 
                   by.x = "kegg_id", by.y = "CompoundID", 
                   all.x = TRUE)

names(merged_df)[names(merged_df) == "PathwayID"] <- "hsa_id"
names(merged_df)[names(merged_df) == "Name"] <- "hsa_name"
names(merged_df)[names(merged_df) == "Class"] <- "hsa_class"

peak_anno_updated <- merged_df %>% arrange(Mass)
```

#### Load Data and Prepare assay

```{r}
peak_anno_updated <- read.csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/RCC_Annotated_Mass_Updated_LM.csv")

assay <- data %>% dplyr::select(`m/z`, intensity, ID) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = ID, values_from = intensity, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("m/z") %>% as.matrix()
```

## 3. Zero Value Imputation

```{r}
assay <- data %>% dplyr::select(`m/z`, intensity, ID) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = ID, values_from = intensity, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("m/z") %>% as.matrix()
assay <- assay %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()

# function to impute 0 values by 1/5 min per feature
replace_zeros <- function(column) {
  min_val <- min(column[column != 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  imp_val <- min_val / 5
  column[column == 0] <- imp_val
  #print(imp_val)
  return(column)
}

# Apply the function to columns
assay_imputed <- assay %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), replace_zeros))

assay_imputed <- assay_imputed %>% t()
```

### Visualization

```{r}

  labs(title = "",
       x = "Intensity",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_classic()+
  xlim(c(0, 1000))
```

```{r}
df <- assay_imputed %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
df$TMA <- raw_out$TMA[match(rownames(df), raw_out$ID)]
df_long <- df %>% pivot_longer(cols = -TMA, names_to = "mz", values_to = "intensity")

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = mz, y = intensity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 5))
```

## 4. Batch effect correction

### Mutual Nearest Neighbor Correction

Decided for mnn correction.

```{r}
library(batchelor)
library(BiocNeighbors)

batch <- TMA_anno$TMA[match(colnames(assay_log), TMA_anno$ID)]
available_cores <- parallel::detectCores()
workers <- (available_cores - 2) / 2
mnn_corrected <- mnnCorrect(assay_log, batch = batch,  # SE$TMA
                            auto.merge = TRUE,
                            #assay.type = "expression",
                            BNPARAM = HnswParam(),
                            BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = workers, RNGseed = 22))

mnn_data <- assay(mnn_corrected)
```

## 5. Prepare SummarizedExperiment

Construct SummarizedExperiment

```{r}
assay <- mnn_data

colData <- data %>% dplyr::select(PID, ID, TMA, spot_ID, subtype_combined, Block_ID, Grid) %>% unique

SE <- SummarizedExperiment(assays=list(exprs=assay %>% as.matrix), colData=colData)
SE
# 443 patients 
# 93 metabolites
```

```{r}
to_add <- c("gender", "age", "age_bin", "type", "status_OS", "OS_months", "pT_simple", "pT_combined", 
"ISUP_simple", "ISUP_combined", "necrose")

add_to_SE <- function(x){
  SE[[x]] <<- metadata_selected[[x]][match(SE$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
}

for (col_name in to_add){
  add_to_SE(col_name)
}

# Save sce
saveRDS(SE, "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/SE_MALDI_01.rds")
```


```{r}
# Update peak annotation
peak_anno_updated <- peak_anno_updated %>% filter(Mass %in% (assay(SE) %>% rownames))

write.csv(peak_anno_updated, file = "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/RCC_Annotated_Mass_Filtered_LM.csv", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
```


### Global min-max scaling

Across all channels

```{r}
min_val <- min(assay(SE))
max_val <- max(assay(SE))

assay(SE, "min_max") <- (assay(SE) - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)

# save
saveRDS(SE, "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/SE_MALDI_01.rds")
```
